# Post Post-Mortem

Why a post overperformed or flopped, in plain terms.

Use for explaining why one specific post did well or badly. Not for finding their best post.

**The user might say:** "Explain why this post performed the way it did compared with my usual numbers: [post link]"

## Steps

1. The post and its numbers.
   ```sh
   xholic posts get --tweet-id <id or URL>
   ```
2. How it compares with their normal.
   ```sh
   xholic analytics content --range 90d --search "<words from the post>"
   ```
3. What usually works for them.
   ```sh
   xholic insights whats-working --range 90d
   ```
4. Explain in plain terms why it over- or underperformed.
